facts.fact: The Malawi Electoral Commission gave all 23 political parties the electronic voters' register on 12 May 2025 and said it would deploy over 15,200 biometric voter identification devices scanning fingerprints against a preloaded biometric database.
MEC said the register inspection closed on 31 May 2025, with 479,115 voters verifying their details at centres and 605,217 using the USSD code *2509# as of 5 June.

systems.system: electronic voters' register and biometric voter identification devices
